title: Beyoncé Drops ‘Morning Dew (Donk)’ Remix Pack Featuring JAŸ-Z
summary: The four-track EP dropped in the small hours of Wednesday morning (Aug. 5), and features contributions from JAŸ-Z on two cuts.
contentText:
Beyoncé is full of surprises.

Several weeks after the release of “Morning Dew (Donk),” Bey surprise-releases the “Morning Dew (Donk)” Remix Pack, a four-pack with two cuts featuring the talents of her hubby, the hip-hop superstar Jay-Z.

The EP dropped in the small hours of Wednesday morning (Aug. 5), alerted to the Beyhive by way of a social post from Parkwood Entertainment .

Written by Beyoncé, Pharrell Williams, The-Dream and Darius Dixon, Beyonce announced “Morning Dew (Donk)” on the 4th of July weekend, an official release closing a chapter on demos leaked in recent years.

On the Remix Pack, Jay-Z — he’s listed as JAŸ-Z (with an umlaut over the “Y”) — jumps in with a fresh rhyme. “Top of the top, sloppy as a morning dew / the watch is vintage, I don’t need nothing new / coming through Malibu in the old school,” he raps. Jay’s vocals also appear on an “acoustic” version.

Beyonce returned to the top 10 of  Billboard ’s  Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs  chart for the first time in three years as “Morning Dew (Donk)” bowed at No. 7 on the tally dated July 18. Meanwhile, “Morning Dew” started at No. 3 on  Hot R&B Songs  and No. 26 on the  Billboard Hot 100 , becoming her 61st top 40 title.

The song was,  reportedly , recorded back in 2013 around the  Beyoncé  album era; a snippet leaked in 2021 before a fuller version made its way online two years later, even sparking  TikTok trends .

“Morning Dew” will appear on a  20th anniversary  deluxe edition of Beyoncé’s sophomore album,  B’Day . The set, released in September 2006,  debuted at No. 1  on the Billboard 200 and ignited the smash “Irreplaceable,” the 2007 year-end Hot 100 No. 1 single. Additional hits included “Beautiful Liar,” with Shakira (No. 3), “Deja Vu,” feat. Jay-Z (No. 4) and “Ring the Alarm” (No. 11).
